translations.web: Yahweh has made his holy arm bare in the eyes of all the nations. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
translations.bsb: The LORD has bared His holy arm in the sight of all the nations; all the ends of the earth will see the salvation of our God.
translations.kjv: The LORD hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God.
translations.asv: Jehovah hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
